entries.name: About Document Viewer
entries.meaning: Displays application version, developer credits, and update links.
entries.where: Apple Menu > About Document Viewer or Help > About Document Viewer
steps: Click the Apple Menu or Help Menu.
Select About Document Viewer.
Review version information or click Check for Updates...

entries.name: Add Image Overlay
entries.meaning: Overlays an external image or graphics layer onto the current image or PDF document page.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Add Image Overlay (Ctrl+Shift+I) or Edit Menu > Add Image Overlay...
steps: Open any image or PDF document.
Click Add Image Overlay in the Markup Toolbar or press Ctrl + Shift + I.
Choose an image file or paste an image from clipboard with Ctrl + V.
Drag to reposition or drag corner handles to resize the overlay layer.

entries.name: Add Image Overlay...
entries.meaning: Opens a file dialog to overlay another image or graphic onto the active page.
entries.where: Edit > Add Image Overlay... or Tools > Add Image Overlay...
steps: Select Edit > Add Image Overlay... or Tools > Add Image Overlay...
Pick a photo, logo, badge, or graphic file from your disk.
The image is inserted as an interactive layer on the current page.

entries.name: Actual Size
entries.meaning: Displays the document at 100 percent scale matching original pixel dimensions.
entries.where: View > Actual Size or Canvas Context Menu > Actual Size
steps: Open any document or image.
Select View > Actual Size or press Ctrl + 0.
Scroll or pan to inspect details at 1:1 pixel resolution.

entries.name: Adjust Color
entries.meaning: Fine-tunes image exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature, tint, and sharpness.
entries.where: Tools > Adjust Color... or Markup Toolbar > Adjust Color
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl + Alt + C.
Drag sliders to adjust tone or click Auto Levels.
Click Done to apply changes or click Revert.

entries.name: Adjust Size
entries.meaning: Resizes image pixel dimensions and changes dots-per-inch print resolution.
entries.where: Tools > Adjust Size... or Markup Toolbar > Adjust Size
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Size... or press Ctrl + Alt + S.
Enter target dimensions in pixels or percentage.
Click OK to resize the image.

entries.name: Align Center
entries.meaning: Centers text lines horizontally within active text annotation boxes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Text Alignment Dropdown > Align Center
steps: Select a text box on canvas.
Click the Text Alignment dropdown on Markup Toolbar.
Select Align Center.

entries.name: Align Left
entries.meaning: Aligns text lines to the left margin within text annotation boxes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Text Alignment Dropdown > Align Left
steps: Select a text box on canvas.
Click the Text Alignment dropdown on Markup Toolbar.
Select Align Left.

entries.name: Align Right
entries.meaning: Aligns text lines to the right margin within text annotation boxes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Text Alignment Dropdown > Align Right
steps: Select a text box on canvas.
Click the Text Alignment dropdown on Markup Toolbar.
Select Align Right.

entries.name: Apply All Redactions
entries.meaning: Permanently burns black redaction boxes into document pages, destroying covered data.
entries.where: Edit > Apply All Redactions
steps: Draw black redaction boxes over sensitive text.
Select Edit > Apply All Redactions.
Click Yes to confirm permanent data removal.

entries.name: Apply Permanent Redactions
entries.meaning: Permanently scrubs redacted pixels and underlying text bytes from the file.
entries.where: Edit > Apply All Redactions or Canvas Redaction Menu
steps: Mark redaction boxes over sensitive text.
Select Edit > Apply All Redactions.
Confirm the irreversible sanitization prompt.

entries.name: Arrow Tool
entries.meaning: Draws directional vector arrows to highlight key areas on canvas.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Shapes Dropdown > Arrow
steps: Click the Markup button on the top toolbar.
Click the Shapes dropdown and select Arrow.
Drag on the canvas from start to arrowhead endpoint.

entries.name: Auto Levels
entries.meaning: Automatically optimizes tonal balance and contrast distribution for images.
entries.where: Adjust Color Panel > Auto Levels
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl + Alt + C.
Click the Auto Levels button.
Click Done to accept the adjusted balance.

entries.name: Bold Text
entries.meaning: Toggles bold typography styling for selected text annotation boxes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Bold (B) Button
steps: Select a text annotation box on the canvas.
Click the B button on the Markup Toolbar.
Type your formatted text.

entries.name: Border / Stroke Color
entries.meaning: Sets outline stroke color for shapes, sketches, and text borders.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Border / Stroke Color Dropdown
steps: Click the Border / Stroke Color dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Select any curated swatch like Red, Blue, or Black.
Choose Show Colors... for full system color palette.

entries.name: Check for Updates
entries.meaning: Checks GitHub releases for new versions and downloads updates.
entries.where: Apple Menu > Check for Updates... or Help > Check for Updates...
steps: Select Check for Updates... from Apple or Help menu.
Read release notes in the update window.
Click Download & Install to update.

entries.name: Clear Recent Menu
entries.meaning: Clears the saved history of recently opened documents from settings.
entries.where: File > Open Recent > Clear Menu
steps: Open the File menu.
Hover over Open Recent.
Click Clear Menu at the bottom of the list.

entries.name: Close Window
entries.meaning: Closes current window and prompts to save if edits are unsaved.
entries.where: File > Close Window or Red Traffic Light Button
steps: Select File > Close Window or press Ctrl + W.
Click Save, Don't Save, or Cancel if prompted.

entries.name: Contact Sheet View
entries.meaning: Displays document pages in a multi-column visual grid layout.
entries.where: Sidebar Header Dropdown > Contact Sheet
steps: Click the Sidebar button on toolbar to open the sidebar.
Click the view dropdown at the top of the sidebar.
Select Contact Sheet to browse pages in a grid.

entries.name: Contrast Slider
entries.meaning: Increases or decreases contrast separation between light and dark tones.
entries.where: Adjust Color Panel > Contrast Slider
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl + Alt + C.
Drag the Contrast slider left or right.
Click Done to apply your changes.

entries.name: Copy Current Page Text
entries.meaning: Extracts and copies all textual words on active page to clipboard.
entries.where: Canvas Context Menu > Copy Page Text
steps: Right-click any empty area on canvas.
Select Copy Page Text.
Paste into external text editors.

entries.name: Copy Text
entries.meaning: Copies selected document text or entire page text to system clipboard.
entries.where: Edit > Copy Text or Canvas Context Menu > Copy Selection
steps: Drag over document text with your mouse to select it.
Select Edit > Copy Text or press Ctrl + C.
Paste the text into any target application.

entries.name: Crop Selection
entries.meaning: Trims document boundaries to the active rectangular, oval, or lasso marquee.
entries.where: Tools > Crop or Markup Toolbar > Crop Selection Button
steps: Select Rectangular, Oval, or Lasso from the Selection dropdown.
Drag across the canvas to frame the desired area.
Select Tools > Crop or press Ctrl + K.

entries.name: Dark / Light Theme Toggle
entries.meaning: Switches the entire interface between macOS Dark mode and Light mode.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Theme Button or Apple Menu > Toggle Dark/Light Theme
steps: Click the sun/moon icon button on the top toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + T to toggle themes immediately.

entries.name: Delete Page
entries.meaning: Permanently removes the selected page from the active PDF document.
entries.where: Sidebar Thumbnail Context Menu > Delete Page
steps: Open the sidebar and locate the target page thumbnail.
Right-click the thumbnail card.
Select Delete Page or press the Delete key.

entries.name: Duplicate / Save As New Copy
entries.meaning: Saves an independent copy of the document without altering the original.
entries.where: File > Duplicate / Save As New Copy...
steps: Select File > Duplicate / Save As New Copy...
Choose a target directory and file name.
Click Save to create the new document copy.

entries.name: Duplicate Page
entries.meaning: Duplicates the selected page and inserts the clone immediately after.
entries.where: Sidebar Thumbnail Context Menu > Duplicate Page
steps: Right-click any page thumbnail card in the sidebar.
Select Duplicate Page from the context menu.
Verify the cloned page appears directly below.

entries.name: Exit Slideshow
entries.meaning: Leaves full-screen presentation mode and restores the standard window.
entries.where: Slideshow Overlay or Press Esc
steps: Press Esc while in slideshow mode.
The application returns to normal window view.

entries.name: Export as PDF
entries.meaning: Directly exports current document and annotations as a standard PDF file.
entries.where: File > Export as PDF...
steps: Select File > Export as PDF... or press Ctrl + Shift + E.
Specify target destination and file name.
Click Save to generate the PDF.

entries.name: Export Dialog
entries.meaning: Exports files to PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, or TIFF with resolution options.
entries.where: File > Export...
steps: Select File > Export... or press Ctrl + E.
Choose the output format, quality, and DPI resolution.
Click Save to write the converted file to disk.

entries.name: Exposure Slider
entries.meaning: Brightens or darkens image highlights and overall light exposure.
entries.where: Adjust Color Panel > Exposure Slider
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl + Alt + C.
Drag the Exposure slider to lighten or darken the picture.
Click Done to confirm the adjustment.

entries.name: Extract All Text to Clipboard
entries.meaning: Copies text across all pages in the document to system clipboard.
entries.where: Edit > Extract All Text to File... or Canvas Context Menu
steps: Select Edit > Extract All Text to File...
Save text to disk or copy directly.

entries.name: Extract All Text to File
entries.meaning: Extracts entire text content across all pages into a plain text file.
entries.where: Edit > Extract All Text to File...
steps: Open any PDF document containing readable text.
Select Edit > Extract All Text to File...
Select a target text file name and click Save.

entries.name: Fill Color
entries.meaning: Selects the interior fill color or transparent background for shapes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Fill Color Dropdown
steps: Click the Fill Color dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Select No Fill (Transparent) or choose a color swatch.
Choose Show Colors... to pick any custom tint.

entries.name: First Page / Image
entries.meaning: Navigates directly to the very first page or image of the document.
entries.where: Go > First Page / Image
steps: Select Go > First Page / Image.
Or press the Home key on your keyboard.

entries.name: Font Controls
entries.meaning: Customizes font family, point size, weight, and alignment for text boxes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Font Size, Font Family, Bold, Italic, Alignment
steps: Select an existing text annotation on the canvas.
Select a font family and font size from the toolbar controls.
Click Bold, Italic, or Underline to format.

entries.name: Font Family
entries.meaning: Selects typography typeface family for active text annotation boxes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Font Family Combobox
steps: Select a text box on canvas.
Click the Font Family dropdown on Markup Toolbar.
Choose an installed system font like Inter or SF Pro.

entries.name: Font Size
entries.meaning: Sets font point size from 8 pt up to 72 pt for text annotations.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Font Size Spinbox
steps: Select a text box on canvas.
Adjust the Font Size spinbox on Markup Toolbar.
Text size scales immediately.

entries.name: Frameless Window Mode
entries.meaning: Removes standard window borders for a sleek macOS traffic light title bar.
entries.where: View > Frameless Window Mode
steps: Select View > Frameless Window Mode or press F11.
Press F11 again to restore standard window borders.

entries.name: Full Screen
entries.meaning: Expands the document viewer to occupy the entire screen display.
entries.where: View > Full Screen or Header Bar > Full Screen Button
steps: Click the Full Screen button on the top toolbar or press F11.
The application expands to full screen presentation.
Press F11 or Esc to exit full screen.

entries.name: Go to Page
entries.meaning: Opens a number prompt to jump directly to any document page.
entries.where: Go > Go to Page...
steps: Select Go > Go to Page... or press Ctrl + G.
Type your target page number.
Press Enter or click OK.

entries.name: Help Window
entries.meaning: Opens the complete Preview documentation system and feature dictionary.
entries.where: Help > Preview Help
steps: Select Help > Preview Help or press F1.
Use the left navigation tree or search box to find topics.
Press Esc to close the Help window.

entries.name: Highlighter Tool
entries.meaning: Draws semi-transparent fluorescent yellow highlights over text and images.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Highlighter Button
steps: Click the Markup button on the top toolbar.
Click the Highlighter tool button.
Drag over document text or pictures to highlight.

entries.name: Insert Blank Page
entries.meaning: Inserts a new blank white page directly after the current document page.
entries.where: Edit > Insert Blank Page or Sidebar Thumbnail Context Menu
steps: Select Edit > Insert Blank Page or press Ctrl + Shift + N.
Or right-click a thumbnail and pick Insert Blank Page After.

entries.name: Insert Page from File
entries.meaning: Inserts external PDF pages or images into the active document.
entries.where: Sidebar Thumbnail Context Menu > Insert Page from File...
steps: Right-click any thumbnail card in the sidebar.
Select Insert Page from File...
Select external PDF or image files to append.

entries.name: Inspector
entries.meaning: Displays document dimensions, file size, color profile, and PDF metadata.
entries.where: Tools > Show Inspector or Top Toolbar > Inspector Button
steps: Click the Inspector button on the top toolbar or press Ctrl + I.
Review General Info for dimensions, DPI, and format.
Click the PDF Details tab for author and keyword metadata.

entries.name: Italic Text
entries.meaning: Toggles italic font formatting for active text annotation boxes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Italic (I) Button
steps: Select a text annotation on canvas.
Click the I button on the Markup Toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + I while editing text.

entries.name: Keyboard Shortcuts Guide
entries.meaning: Displays a complete categorized reference table of all application shortcuts.
entries.where: Help > Keyboard Shortcuts Guide
steps: Select Help > Keyboard Shortcuts Guide.
Review shortcuts organized by menu category.

entries.name: Lasso Selection
entries.meaning: Draws freehand polygonal selection boundaries to crop irregular shapes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Selection Dropdown > Lasso Selection
steps: Click the Selection dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Select Lasso Selection.
Drag around the irregular area to create a closed selection.

entries.name: Last Page / Image
entries.meaning: Jumps directly to the final page or image in the active document.
entries.where: Go > Last Page / Image
steps: Select Go > Last Page / Image.
Or press the End key on your keyboard.

entries.name: Line Style / Thickness
entries.meaning: Selects stroke thickness from 1 px fine hairline up to 12 px heavy line.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Line Style / Thickness Dropdown
steps: Click the Line Style / Thickness dropdown on Markup Toolbar.
Select a thickness: 1 px, 2 px, 3 px, 5 px, 8 px, or 12 px.

entries.name: Line Tool
entries.meaning: Draws straight vector line segments on document canvas.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Shapes Dropdown > Line
steps: Click the Shapes dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Select Line.
Drag across canvas from start point to end point.

entries.name: Loupe / Magnifier
entries.meaning: Displays a circular magnifying glass following your cursor for close inspection.
entries.where: Tools > Show Magnifier (Loupe) or press ~ / `
steps: Press the tilde (~) key or backtick (`) key.
Move your cursor over document details to inspect zoomed pixels.
Press ~ or ` again to dismiss the magnifier.

entries.name: macOS Frameless Window
entries.meaning: Removes native window decorations for clean macOS integrated appearance.
entries.where: View > Frameless Window Mode
steps: Select View > Frameless Window Mode or press F11.
Window border toggles seamlessly.

entries.name: Markup Toolbar
entries.meaning: Secondary toolbar providing sketch, highlighter, shapes, text, and note tools.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Markup Pill Button or Tools > Show Markup Toolbar
steps: Click the Markup button on the top toolbar or press Ctrl + Shift + A.
Select any annotation tool to draw on canvas.
Click the Markup button again to hide the secondary toolbar.

entries.name: Merge PDFs
entries.meaning: Combines two or more independent PDF files into a single continuous document.
entries.where: File > Merge PDFs...
steps: Select File > Merge PDFs...
Select at least two PDF files to merge.
Choose a target file name and click Save.

entries.name: Minimize Window
entries.meaning: Minimizes the Preview application window to your system taskbar or dock.
entries.where: Window > Minimize or Yellow Traffic Light Button
steps: Select Window > Minimize or press Ctrl + M.
Click the app icon on your system taskbar to restore.

entries.name: Next Page / Image
entries.meaning: Advances view to the next document page or folder image.
entries.where: Go > Next Page / Image or Top Toolbar > Next Arrow Button
steps: Click the right arrow button on the top toolbar.
Or press Right Arrow, Down Arrow, or Page Down.
entries.shortcut: Right Arrow / Down Arrow / Page Down

entries.name: Open Document or Images
entries.meaning: Primary open action loading supported PDF documents or raster graphics.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Open Button or File > Open...
steps: Click the Open button on the top toolbar.
Select files and click Open.

entries.name: Open File
entries.meaning: Opens a single PDF document or supported image file.
entries.where: File > Open... or Top Toolbar > Open Button
steps: Click the Open button on the top toolbar or press Ctrl + O.
Select your file in the file chooser.
Click Open.

entries.name: Open Folder of Images
entries.meaning: Loads all supported images within a selected directory as a multi-page book.
entries.where: File > Open Folder... or Top Toolbar > Open Segmented Arrow
steps: Select File > Open Folder... or press Ctrl + Shift + O.
Choose any folder containing images.
Click Open to browse all images in sequence.

entries.name: Open Options
entries.meaning: Dropdown menu next to Open button providing single file or folder loading.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Open Segmented Dropdown Arrow
steps: Click the small arrow next to the Open toolbar button.
Choose Open File(s)... or Open Folder of Images...

entries.name: Open Recent
entries.meaning: Submenu providing quick access to the 10 most recently opened files.
entries.where: File > Open Recent
steps: Select File > Open Recent.
Click any document path to open it immediately.

entries.name: Oval / Circle Shape
entries.meaning: Draws vector ellipses and circles with custom stroke and fill colors.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Shapes Dropdown > Oval / Circle
steps: Click the Shapes dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Select Oval / Circle.
Drag on the canvas to draw the shape.

entries.name: Oval / Elliptical Selection
entries.meaning: Creates an elliptical selection marquee to crop or rotate circular areas.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Selection Dropdown > Oval / Elliptical Selection
steps: Click the Selection dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Choose Oval / Elliptical Selection.
Drag over canvas to mark the elliptical area.

entries.name: Page Number Pill
entries.meaning: Visual badge showing the active page number and total page count.
entries.where: Top Toolbar Title Widget & Sidebar Thumbnail Delegate
steps: Check the badge next to the title or below thumbnail cards.
The active page displays highlighted in accent blue.

entries.name: Password and Encryption
entries.meaning: Protects sensitive PDF files with standard AES-256 password encryption.
entries.where: File > Set PDF Password / Encryption...
steps: Open your target PDF document.
Select File > Set PDF Password / Encryption...
Type a secure password and save the file.

entries.name: Pause / Resume Auto-advance
entries.meaning: Pauses or resumes automatic timed slide advancement during presentations.
entries.where: Slideshow Mode Toolbar or Press Space
steps: Start slideshow by pressing F5.
Press Spacebar to pause or resume timer.

entries.name: Pen Tool (Sketch)
entries.meaning: Draws freehand smooth vector sketch strokes on canvas.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Pen Button
steps: Click the Pen tool button on the Markup Toolbar.
Choose your stroke color and line thickness.
Drag on canvas to draw freehand lines.

entries.name: Pointer / Select Tool
entries.meaning: Deactivates active drawing tools and resets cursor to normal selection mode.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Pointer Button
steps: Click the Pointer button on the Markup Toolbar.
Or press the Esc key on your keyboard.

entries.name: Preferences
entries.meaning: Configures update checks, theme defaults, and startup preferences.
entries.where: Apple Menu > Preferences...
steps: Select Preferences... from the Apple Menu or press Ctrl + ,.
Configure your application options.

entries.name: Previous Page / Image
entries.meaning: Goes back to the preceding document page or folder image.
entries.where: Go > Previous Page / Image or Top Toolbar > Previous Arrow Button
steps: Click the left arrow button on the top toolbar.
Or press Left Arrow, Up Arrow, or Page Up.
entries.shortcut: Left Arrow / Up Arrow / Page Up

entries.name: Print
entries.meaning: Sends the active document or image to your system printer.
entries.where: File > Print...
steps: Select File > Print... or press Ctrl + P.
Configure target printer, paper size, and copies.
Click Print to send the job.

entries.name: Print Preview
entries.meaning: Previews exact printer pagination and margins before printing.
entries.where: File > Print Preview...
steps: Select File > Print Preview... or press Ctrl + Shift + P.
Inspect margins, orientation, and layout.
Click Print to proceed.

entries.name: Quick Styles / Alignment
entries.meaning: Aligns text Left, Center, or Right and selects preset point sizes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Text Alignment Dropdown (A)
steps: Select a text annotation on canvas.
Click the Text Alignment dropdown on Markup Toolbar.
Choose Align Left, Align Center, or Align Right.

entries.name: Quit Document Viewer
entries.meaning: Closes all documents and exits the application cleanly.
entries.where: Apple Menu > Quit Document Viewer
steps: Select Apple Menu > Quit Document Viewer or press Ctrl + Q.
Confirm or save changes if prompted.

entries.name: Rectangle Shape
entries.meaning: Draws vector rectangular borders and filled boxes on canvas.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Shapes Dropdown > Rectangle
steps: Click the Shapes dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Select Rectangle.
Drag on canvas to place the rectangle.

entries.name: Rectangular Selection
entries.meaning: Draws standard four-corner marquee boxes for cropping and area rotation.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Selection Dropdown > Rectangular Selection
steps: Click the Selection dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Select Rectangular Selection.
Drag across canvas to frame the rectangular region.

entries.name: Redaction Tool
entries.meaning: Marks rectangular blackout bars over confidential text or images.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Redact Button
steps: Click the Redaction tool on the Markup Toolbar.
Drag over private text or sensitive numbers.
Select Edit > Apply All Redactions to permanently sanitize.

entries.name: Redo
entries.meaning: Re-applies the most recently undone annotation or editing action.
entries.where: Edit > Redo
steps: Select Edit > Redo.
Or press Ctrl + Shift + Z.

entries.name: Revert to Original
entries.meaning: Discards all session modifications and reloads the file from disk.
entries.where: File > Revert to Original...
steps: Select File > Revert to Original...
Confirm the reload prompt.
The document resets to its pristine disk state.

entries.name: Rotate 90° Clockwise
entries.meaning: Rotates current page or selected thumbnail 90 degrees clockwise.
entries.where: Sidebar Thumbnail Context Menu > Rotate 90° Clockwise
steps: Right-click any thumbnail card in the sidebar.
Select Rotate 90° Clockwise.
Page rotates in document structure.

entries.name: Rotate 90° Counter-Clockwise
entries.meaning: Rotates current page or selected thumbnail 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
entries.where: Sidebar Thumbnail Context Menu > Rotate 90° Counter-Clockwise
steps: Right-click any thumbnail card in the sidebar.
Select Rotate 90° Counter-Clockwise.
Page rotates in document structure.

entries.name: Rotate Left
entries.meaning: Rotates current document page or image 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
entries.where: Tools > Rotate Left or Markup Toolbar > Rotate Left Button
steps: Select Tools > Rotate Left.
Or press Ctrl + L.

entries.name: Rotate Left 90°
entries.meaning: Rotates current canvas view 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Rotate Left Button
steps: Click the Rotate Left button on Markup Toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + L.

entries.name: Rotate Right
entries.meaning: Rotates current document page or image 90 degrees clockwise.
entries.where: Tools > Rotate Right or Top Toolbar > Rotate Button
steps: Click the Rotate button on the top toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + R.

entries.name: Rotate Selection
entries.meaning: Rotates only the active selected area or annotation 90 degrees clockwise.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Rotate Selection Button or Canvas Selection Menu
steps: Create a rectangular, oval, or lasso selection.
Click the Rotate Selection button on the Markup Toolbar.
Or right-click the selection and choose Rotate Selection 90°.

entries.name: Rotate Selection 90°
entries.meaning: Rotates active marquee crop area 90 degrees clockwise.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Rotate Selection Button
steps: Draw a selection marquee on canvas.
Click the Rotate Selection button or press Ctrl + R.

entries.name: Rounded Rectangle Shape
entries.meaning: Draws vector rectangles with smooth rounded corner fillets.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Shapes Dropdown > Rounded Rectangle
steps: Click the Shapes dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Select Rounded Rectangle.
Drag on canvas to place the rounded box.

entries.name: Saturation Slider
entries.meaning: Adjusts intensity of image color vividness from grayscale to rich color.
entries.where: Adjust Color Panel > Saturation Slider
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl + Alt + C.
Drag the Saturation slider to increase or decrease color vibrancy.
Click Done to apply.

entries.name: Save
entries.meaning: Saves all current annotations, rotations, and edits directly into the file.
entries.where: File > Save
steps: Select File > Save.
Or press Ctrl + S.

entries.name: Save Changes Prompt
entries.meaning: Alert sheet protecting against accidental data loss when closing edited files.
entries.where: Displayed automatically when closing documents with unsaved changes
steps: Press Enter or click Save to save modifications.
Press Alt + D or click Don't Save to discard changes.
Press Esc or click Cancel to stay in the document.

entries.name: Scale Proportionally
entries.meaning: Locks the aspect ratio so image proportions do not distort when resizing.
entries.where: Adjust Size Dialog > Scale proportionally Checkbox
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Size... or press Ctrl + Alt + S.
Ensure Scale proportionally remains checked.
Enter a new width, and the height calculates automatically.

entries.name: Search Field
entries.meaning: Searches text across document pages with immediate highlight feedback.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Search Input Box
steps: Click the Search input box on the top toolbar.
Type your query keyword and press Enter.
Matches highlight across pages on the canvas.

entries.name: Selection Tools
entries.meaning: Dropdown offering Rectangular, Oval, and Lasso selection marquee modes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Selection Dropdown
steps: Click the Selection dropdown on Markup Toolbar.
Choose Rectangular, Oval, or Lasso Selection.
Drag on canvas to frame an area.

entries.name: Sepia Tone
entries.meaning: Applies warm brownish antique monochrome toning to photographic imagery.
entries.where: Adjust Color Panel > Sepia Tone Checkbox
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl + Alt + C.
Check the Sepia Tone checkbox.
Click Done to apply the vintage coloring.

entries.name: Shapes
entries.meaning: Dropdown menu providing Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Oval, Line, and Arrow tools.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Shapes Button
steps: Click the Shapes button on Markup Toolbar.
Pick Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Oval, Line, or Arrow.
Drag on canvas to place the vector shape.

entries.name: Sharpness Slider
entries.meaning: Sharpens edge clarity or softens harsh textures in photographic images.
entries.where: Adjust Color Panel > Sharpness Slider
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl + Alt + C.
Drag the Sharpness slider to enhance edge definition.
Click Done to save the filtered image.

entries.name: Show Colors...
entries.meaning: Opens full system color picker dialog for custom stroke and fill colors.
entries.where: Stroke or Fill Color Dropdown > Show Colors...
steps: Click Stroke Color or Fill Color dropdown.
Click Show Colors... at the bottom.
Pick any hue, saturation, and luminance.

entries.name: Show Menu Bar
entries.meaning: Shows or hides the top application menubar for compact viewing.
entries.where: View > Toggle Menu Bar
steps: Select View > Toggle Menu Bar.
Menubar toggles between visible and hidden.

entries.name: Show Status Bar
entries.meaning: Displays bottom bar containing zoom percentage and page count details.
entries.where: View > Toggle Status Bar
steps: Select View > Toggle Status Bar.
Status bar toggles visible or hidden.

entries.name: Sidebar
entries.meaning: Collapsible left panel displaying Thumbnails, Contact Sheet, or Outline.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Sidebar Button or View > Toggle Sidebar
steps: Click the Sidebar button on the top toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + B to toggle visibility.

entries.name: Sidebar Size Slider
entries.meaning: Adjusts the width and height of page thumbnail cards in the sidebar.
entries.where: Sidebar Footer > Slider
steps: Open the left sidebar.
Drag the horizontal slider in the sidebar footer.
Thumbnails expand from 70 px up to 220 px.

entries.name: Signature Tool
entries.meaning: Draws and places transparent vector signatures on contracts and documents.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Signatures Button
steps: Click the Signatures button on the Markup Toolbar.
Draw your signature with mouse or trackpad on the pad.
Click Insert Signature to place it onto the page.

entries.name: Single Page View
entries.meaning: Displays one page at a time centered cleanly in the canvas viewport.
entries.where: View > PDF View Mode > Single Page
steps: Select View > PDF View Mode > Single Page.
Navigate pages sequentially using arrow keys.

entries.name: Slideshow Mode
entries.meaning: Presents document pages in a distraction-free full-screen presentation mode.
entries.where: View > Slideshow Mode
steps: Select View > Slideshow Mode or press F5.
Use arrow keys to advance slides.
Press Esc to exit presentation mode.

entries.name: Split PDF / Extract Pages
entries.meaning: Extracts specified page numbers or ranges into a separate new PDF document.
entries.where: File > Split PDF / Extract Pages...
steps: Open a multi-page PDF document.
Select File > Split PDF / Extract Pages...
Enter page numbers or ranges like 1-3, 5 and click OK.

entries.name: Start Slideshow
entries.meaning: Launches full-screen black-background slideshow presentation mode.
entries.where: View > Slideshow Mode or Press F5
steps: Select View > Slideshow Mode.
Use arrow keys to navigate slides.
Press Esc to exit.

entries.name: Sticky Note Tool
entries.meaning: Places yellow popover Post-it note annotations for comments and reminders.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Note Button
steps: Click the Note button on the Markup Toolbar.
Click on the document page where you want the note.
Type your comments and click Done.

entries.name: Strikethrough Selected Text
entries.meaning: Draws a horizontal cancellation strike line across highlighted text.
entries.where: Canvas Context Menu (with text selected) > Strikethrough Selected Text
steps: Drag over text to select words on the canvas.
Right-click the selection.
Choose Strikethrough Selected Text.

entries.name: Table of Contents View
entries.meaning: Displays the hierarchical PDF document outline and chapter bookmarks.
entries.where: Sidebar Header Dropdown > Table of Contents
steps: Click the Sidebar button on the top toolbar.
Select Table of Contents from the header view dropdown.
Click any chapter title in the tree to jump to that page.

entries.name: Temperature Slider
entries.meaning: Adjusts white balance warmth from cool blue to warm amber hues.
entries.where: Adjust Color Panel > Temperature Slider
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl + Alt + C.
Drag the Temperature slider left for cooler tones or right for warmer tones.
Click Done to confirm.

entries.name: Text Alignment & Quick Styles
entries.meaning: Dropdown menu offering left, center, right alignment and quick point sizes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Text Alignment Dropdown (A)
steps: Select any text annotation box.
Click the A dropdown on the Markup Toolbar.
Choose text alignment or quick font sizes.

entries.name: Text Box Tool
entries.meaning: Inserts editable vector typography annotation boxes on document pages.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Text Button
steps: Click the Text tool button on the Markup Toolbar.
Click on canvas to place the text box.
Type your message and format using toolbar font controls.

entries.name: Theme Toggle
entries.meaning: Toggles application appearance between macOS Dark Mode and Light Mode.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Theme Button or Apple Menu > Toggle Dark/Light Theme
steps: Click the sun/moon button on the top toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + T.

entries.name: Thumbnails View
entries.meaning: Displays a vertical list of page cards with page number pill badges.
entries.where: Sidebar Header Dropdown > Thumbnails
steps: Click the Sidebar button on the top toolbar or press Ctrl + B.
Select Thumbnails from the sidebar view menu.
Click any page card to jump to it, or drag cards to reorder pages.

entries.name: Tint Slider
entries.meaning: Adjusts green and magenta color cast balance in photographic images.
entries.where: Adjust Color Panel > Tint Slider
steps: Select Tools > Adjust Color... or press Ctrl + Alt + C.
Drag the Tint slider left for green correction or right for magenta.
Click Done to confirm.

entries.name: Toggle Dark/Light Mode
entries.meaning: Switches the active application visual appearance between Dark and Light mode.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Theme Button or Apple Menu > Toggle Dark/Light Theme
steps: Click the sun/moon button on the top toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + T.

entries.name: Toggle Status Bar
entries.meaning: Shows or hides the bottom status information bar displaying document hints.
entries.where: View > Toggle Status Bar
steps: Select View > Toggle Status Bar.
The bottom status line toggles visible or hidden.

entries.name: Traffic Light Buttons
entries.meaning: macOS-authentic Close (red), Minimize (yellow), and Zoom (green) buttons.
entries.where: Top Left of Toolbar in Frameless Mode
steps: Click Red to close window with unsaved verification.
Click Yellow to minimize to taskbar.
Click Green to maximize or restore window.

entries.name: Two Pages (Two-Up)
entries.meaning: Displays document in two-page facing spread layout matching book pages.
entries.where: View > PDF View Mode > Two Pages Continuous (Two-Up)
steps: Select View > PDF View Mode > Two Pages Continuous (Two-Up).
Pages display side by side on canvas.

entries.name: Two Pages Continuous (Two-Up) View
entries.meaning: Displays facing page spreads side by side in a book-style reading layout.
entries.where: View > PDF View Mode > Two Pages Continuous (Two-Up)
steps: Select View > PDF View Mode > Two Pages Continuous (Two-Up).
Scroll through pages as facing book spreads.

entries.name: Underline Text
entries.meaning: Toggles underline text decoration on active text annotation boxes.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Underline (U) Button
steps: Select a text annotation on canvas.
Click the U button on the Markup Toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + U while typing.

entries.name: Undo
entries.meaning: Reverts the previous drawing stroke, annotation, crop, or deletion.
entries.where: Edit > Undo
steps: Select Edit > Undo.
Or press Ctrl + Z.

entries.name: Update Banner
entries.meaning: Non-intrusive notification bar appearing when a new release is detected.
entries.where: Top of window below toolbar when update is available
steps: Click View Update to open the download sheet.
Or click the X button to dismiss the banner.

entries.name: Zoom / Maximize
entries.meaning: Toggles the window between standard size and full desktop workspace.
entries.where: Window > Zoom / Maximize or Green Traffic Light Button
steps: Select Window > Zoom / Maximize.
Window toggles maximized state.

entries.name: Zoom In
entries.meaning: Increases canvas magnification scale by 20 percent.
entries.where: View > Zoom In or Top Toolbar > Zoom In (+) Button
steps: Click the plus (+) button on the top toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + = (or Ctrl + +).
Or hold Ctrl and scroll mouse wheel up.

entries.name: Zoom Out
entries.meaning: Decreases canvas magnification scale by 20 percent.
entries.where: View > Zoom Out or Top Toolbar > Zoom Out (-) Button
steps: Click the minus (-) button on the top toolbar.
Or press Ctrl + -.
Or hold Ctrl and scroll mouse wheel down.

entries.name: Zoom to Fit
entries.meaning: Scales document page to fit completely within the window viewport.
entries.where: View > Zoom to Fit or Canvas Context Menu > Zoom to Fit
steps: Select View > Zoom to Fit.
Or press Ctrl + 9.

entries.name: Zoom to Width
entries.meaning: Scales document page width to fill window width while allowing vertical scroll.
entries.where: View > Zoom to Width
steps: Select View > Zoom to Width.
Page width automatically expands to match canvas viewport width.

entries.name: New Tab
entries.meaning: Opens a new document tab within the current window.
entries.where: File > New Tab or Tab Bar > + button
steps: Select File > New Tab or press Ctrl + T.
Choose a document or image to open in the new tab.

entries.name: Close Tab
entries.meaning: Closes the active document tab and prompts to save unsaved modifications.
entries.where: File > Close Tab or Tab Bar > Close button
steps: Select File > Close Tab or press Ctrl + W.
If changes were made, choose Save or Don't Save.

entries.name: Show Tab Bar
entries.meaning: Toggles visibility of the document tab bar below the toolbar.
entries.where: View > Show Tab Bar
steps: Select View > Show Tab Bar or press Ctrl + Shift + T.

entries.name: Select Next Tab
entries.meaning: Switches focus to the next open document tab.
entries.where: Window > Select Next Tab
steps: Select Window > Select Next Tab or press Ctrl + Tab.

entries.name: Select Previous Tab
entries.meaning: Switches focus to the previous open document tab.
entries.where: Window > Select Previous Tab
steps: Select Window > Select Previous Tab or press Ctrl + Shift + Tab.

entries.name: Edit Mode
entries.meaning: Professional editing workspace providing full annotation, drawing, signing, and markup tools.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Mode Switcher > Edit, or View > Workspace Mode > Edit Mode
steps: Click Edit on the workspace mode switcher or press Alt + 2.
Select text markup, drawing, redaction, or signing tools from the markup bar.
Adjust properties in the dynamic context formatting bar or the right Inspector panel.

entries.name: View Mode
entries.meaning: Clean, distraction-free document browsing and reading workspace.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Mode Switcher > View, or View > Workspace Mode > View Mode
steps: Click View on the workspace mode switcher or press Alt + 1.
Navigate pages with arrow keys or the sidebar.
Zoom and search without distracting editing toolbars.

entries.name: Organize Mode
entries.meaning: Page and document management workspace for rotating, reordering, inserting, deleting, merging, and splitting pages.
entries.where: Top Toolbar > Mode Switcher > Organize, or View > Workspace Mode > Organize Mode
steps: Click Organize on the workspace mode switcher or press Alt + 3.
Review pages in the Contact Sheet grid view.
Use the quick action bar to rotate, duplicate, insert, delete, merge, or split documents.

entries.name: Hand Tool
entries.meaning: Pans and navigates smoothly across the canvas by dragging with the mouse.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Navigation Group > Hand Button
steps: Click the Hand icon in the markup toolbar or press H.
Click and drag anywhere on the document canvas to scroll smoothly.

entries.name: Underline Text Markup
entries.meaning: Draws an authentic underline markup below selected words or paragraphs.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Text Markup Group > Underline Button
steps: Click the Underline tool in the markup toolbar.
Drag across any text on the page to stamp a clean underline annotation.
Customize color and line style in the Inspector panel.

entries.name: Strikethrough Text Markup
entries.meaning: Draws a crisp strikethrough line directly across text or sections.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Text Markup Group > Strikethrough Button
steps: Click the Strikethrough tool in the markup toolbar.
Drag across text on the document to draw a strikethrough markup.
Change color or thickness in the context formatting bar.

entries.name: Text Alignment and Formatting
entries.meaning: Configures font family, font size, bold, italic, underline, alignment, and color for text annotations.
entries.where: Markup Toolbar > Context Formatting Bar or Right Inspector Panel
steps: Select any text annotation box on the canvas.
Use the font family dropdown and size stepper to adjust typography.
Click Bold, Italic, or Underline toggles, and select text color.
